answer: Receipts are issued in nebula, burned on slash in glacier, and listed in vault. That removes the yield an adversary would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 32 epochs. That bill is paid per identity, so 124 aliases cost 374 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
